items.headline: Allen, Jackson, Burrow lead MVP faves; non-QBs lead OROY odds
items.description: Quarterbacks Josh Allen, Lamar Jackson and Joe Burrow lead an early list of NFL MVP favorites, while RB Jeremiyah Love and WR Carnell Tate top Offensive Rookie of the Year odds.

items.headline: What does Aaron Donald being inactive mean for 49ers-Rams?
items.description: What does Aaron Donald being inactive mean for 49ers-Rams?

items.headline: Rams' Donald won't travel to Australia; Garrett 'ready to go'
items.description: Rams standout defensive tackle Aaron Donald will not travel to Australia for Thursday night's opener against the San Francisco 49ers and will be inactive, coach Sean McVay announced Tuesday.

items.headline: What's it like to go against Aaron Donald?
items.description: Sarah Barshop reports on the opponents' reaction to going against Aaron Donald as he returns from retirement.

items.headline: 49ers' Nick Bosa set to face Rams; George Kittle 'looks good'
items.description: All signs point toward San Francisco's Nick Bosa and George Kittle playing in Thursday's season opener versus the Rams.

items.headline: Aaron Donald pleased with progress as Rams' opener nears
items.description: After two seasons out of football, defensive lineman Aaron Donald, 35, has been pleasantly surprised by how his body has reacted since rejoining the Los Angeles Rams last month, telling reporters on Monday that he is "feeling good. Feeling really good."
